vendors.name: Snyk Open Source / Snyk Container
vendors.offering: Developer-first SCA and container scanning with fix PRs across repos and CI
vendors.pricing: Free (Open Source 200 tests, Container 100 tests/month); Team from $25/month per contributing developer; Enterprise custom

vendors.name: GitHub Code Security (Dependabot)
vendors.offering: Dependabot alerts/updates plus premium dependency review bundled into GitHub
vendors.pricing: Code Security $30/active committer/month; basic Dependabot included with GitHub

vendors.name: Sonatype Lifecycle / Repository Firewall
vendors.offering: Dependency policy governance plus malicious/vulnerable package blocking at the repository proxy
vendors.pricing: Firewall Cloud Pro from $4,800/year; Lifecycle cloud Pro from $1,200/year (credits); Enterprise custom

vendors.name: JFrog Advanced Security (Xray)
vendors.offering: SCA, contextual and transitive analysis built into the Artifactory artifact registry
vendors.pricing: not public; Advanced Security listed only on upper Enterprise tiers (Enterprise starts at $950/month)

vendors.name: Docker Scout
vendors.offering: Container image vulnerability analysis, policy and remediation tied to Docker Hub
vendors.pricing: Included in Docker plans: Personal $0 (1 repo), Pro $9-11/user/month (2 repos), Team $15-16/user/month (unlimited)

vendors.name: Socket
vendors.offering: Dependency supply-chain security: malicious package detection and vulnerable dependency alerts
vendors.pricing: Free tier; Team about $25/dev/month, 5-dev minimum (third-party reports)

vendors.name: Endor Labs
vendors.offering: SCA with function-level reachability and upgrade impact analysis to cut noise

vendors.name: Chainguard (Containers, Libraries)
vendors.offering: Minimal low-CVE container images and rebuilt libraries replacing vulnerable upstream dependencies
vendors.pricing: Free Starter (5 users, 5 images); Team paid by credit card, price not shown; Enterprise quote

paid_market_gaps.gap: Update bots do not bump top-level packages to fix vulnerable transitive sub-dependencies
Low-tier repository firewall covers only npm, Maven, PyPI, NuGet; vulnerability and license blocking are Enterprise-only
Teams want CI dependency scanning and SBOMs without granting vendors source-code access
Per-developer pricing causes sticker shock as teams grow to 30-50 developers

wtp_evidence: Buyers pay: Snyk Team from $25/dev/month, Sonatype Firewall from $4,800/year, and public tenders procure Sonatype Lifecycle and Firewall.
bundling_note: GitHub includes Dependabot, Docker includes Scout, AWS Inspector scans ECR and CI images per use, and Docker and Red Hat give hardened images away free.
summary: Crowded and heavily bundled; no opening for another scanner or hardened-image catalog (Minimus shut down amid free competition). Only narrow wedges remain: transitive-fix automation and source-less CI scanning for teams already paying incumbents.
